name: aonarr-web
description: AoNarr is a self-hosted media manager that unifies Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr/Readarr/Prowlarr/Bazarr/Whisparr-style functionality across 10 library types (Movies, TV Shows, Anime, Music, Books, Comics, ROMs, Online Videos, Courses, Adult) in one app. This is the browser UI container. It requires the "aonarr-server" container (same repo, "server" tag) to be installed and running — install that one first. By default this expects the backend container to be named "aonarr-server" and listening on port 8989. If you renamed the server container or changed its port, update the AONARR_SERVER_HOST / AONARR_SERVER_PORT variables below to match. On Unraid, containers on the default bridge network can reach each other by container name.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port the browser UI is served on.

variables.name: Backend Host
variables.description: Container name (or IP) of the aonarr-server container. Must match the Name you gave that container.

variables.name: Backend Port
variables.description: Port the aonarr-server container's API listens on.
